Hand Landmarker model (float16, version 1):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
Model documentation and source terms:
https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker

All files are shipped locally. This app does not send camera frames to
the download hosts. Camera frames are processed inside a local web worker.
